mentions.name: claude-issue-solver
mentions.description: A CLI that automates solving GitHub issues with Claude Code: run claude-issue, pick an issue from a list, and it spins up a git worktree, opens Claude in a new terminal, and auto-creates a pull request when Claude commits, condensing the multi-step issue-fixing workflow into one command.
mentions.problem: The manual workflow of reading an issue, creating a branch, copying issue text, pasting it into Claude, and creating a PR was tedious; this reduces it to a single command.
mentions.audience: Developers working with GitHub issues who use Claude Code for coding assistance.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on claude-issue-solver - a CLI that automates solving GitHub issues with Claude Code.

You run claude-issue, pick an issue from a list, and it spins up a git worktree, opens Claude in a new terminal, and auto-creates a PR when Claude commits.
